{{2021–22 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2021–22 Georgia Southern Eagles men's basketball team''' represented [[Georgia Southern University]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Eagles, led by second-year head coach [[Brian Burg]], played their home games at [[Hanner Fieldhouse]] in [[Statesboro, Georgia]] as members of the [[Sun Belt Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2020–21 Georgia Southern Eagles men's basketball team|Eagles]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 13–13, 7–9 in Sun Belt play to finish in fifth place in the East Division. They were defeated by [[2020–21 Arkansas State Red Wolves men's basketball team|Arkansas State]] in the first round of the [[2021 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sunbeltsports.org/news/2021/3/6/mens-basketball-red-wolves-edge-georgia-southern-in-sbc-tournament-opener.aspx|title=Red Wolves Edge Georgia Southern in SBC Tournament Opener|work=Sun Belt Conference|access-date=October 26, 2021|language=en}}</ref>
